V_YGO_EVENT_FIENDSMITH_FORGE.title: The Fiendsmith's Invitation
V_YGO_EVENT_FIENDSMITH_FORGE.pages.INITI:
The ring of metal echoes from deep within a dim fork in the path. Crimson sparks dance against the stone walls, revealing a pitch-black coffin lined with sharp teeth.

Fiendsmith Engraver sits cross-legged on its lid, as though he has been waiting for quite some time. He looks you over, turning a still-hot engraving tool between his fingers.

‘If we're to travel together, first show me what kind of mark you can bear. If all you want is to sharpen what you're holding—Gold will do.’
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose [blue]{FiendsmithCards}[/blue] ‘Fiendsmith’ cards to add to your Deck.
Lose [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Choose [blue]{UpgradeCards}[/blue] cards to Upgrade.
Requires at least [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold and an upgradable card in your Deck.
V_YGO_EVENT_FIENDSMITH_FORGE.pages.JOINE: The tool descends, and searing lines spread along the wound. A satisfied growl rises from the coffin as the smith leaps down. Several Fiendsmith shadows have quietly joined your party.
V_YGO_EVENT_FIENDSMITH_FORGE.pages.FORGE: The coins roll between the coffin's sharp teeth. The smith takes your card, sparks and engraved lines weaving between his fingers. When he hands it back, its edge is as keen as new.
You give no answer. Before long, the hammering resumes behind you, as though the encounter had never happened.
V_YGO_EVENT_FIENDSMITH_FORGE.selectionSc: Choose {FiendsmithCards} ‘Fiendsmith’ cards to add to your Deck.
V_YGO_EVENT_DECODE_EVOLUTION.title: Decode Evolution
V_YGO_EVENT_DECODE_EVOLUTION.pages.INITI:
Your monster, Decode Talker, has come into contact with an anomalous energy within the network. Chaotic streams of data coil around its armor, forcing its code and body to restructure together.

Orange flames, cyan energy and a dark torrent of data split into three paths before it. Each power calls it toward an entirely different form.

Its evolution is not yet fixed. Choose a new evolutionary path for Decode Talker.
Transform all ‘Decode Talker’ cards in your Deck into ‘Decode Talker Integration’. Upgraded cards remain Upgraded.
Transform all ‘Decode Talker’ cards in your Deck into ‘Decode Talker Heatsoul’. Upgraded cards remain Upgraded.
Transform all ‘Decode Talker’ cards in your Deck into ‘Decode Talker Extended’. Upgraded cards remain Upgraded.
Cut off the anomalous energy and keep the original ‘Decode Talker’.
V_YGO_EVENT_DECODE_EVOLUTION.pages.INTEG: Cyan data streams pour into the core, weaving scattered links into a complete network. As the light fades, Decode Talker Integration grips its reconstructed blade of light.
V_YGO_EVENT_DECODE_EVOLUTION.pages.HEATS: Orange flames erupt through the gaps in its armor as the anomalous energy becomes a blazing soul. Decode Talker Heatsoul emerges proudly from the fire.
V_YGO_EVENT_DECODE_EVOLUTION.pages.EXTEN: Dark data swallows the faint light around it, then compresses into new armor in an instant. Decode Talker Extended steps out of the shadows, its expanded power now fully stable.
You sever the connection in time, and the three currents of energy dissipate. Decode Talker returns to its original form, while its unfinished evolution sinks into the depths of the network.
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.title: Aleister's Ritual
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.pages.INITI:
Beside a desolate road, a magician in dark robes bends over an intricate magic circle. Crimson lines light up one by one along the cracks in the stone, and the air smells of metal and sulfur.

With the final stroke, Aleister Crowley turns and taps the center of the circle with his staff. Six distinct silhouettes of Invoked beasts appear within it.

‘A soul, Gold, or a written contract—choose your price, and I shall show you the true essence of Invocation.’

Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Obtain [gold]Magic Circle Core[/gold], then choose [blue]{InvokedCards}[/blue] of [blue]{InvokedCandidates}[/blue] ‘Invoked’ Fusion Monsters to add to your Extra Deck.
Obtain [blue]{RareFusionCards}[/blue] random Upgraded [gold]Rare[/gold] Fusion Monster cards.
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.pages.SOUL_: The magic circle draws a pale strand of light from your shadow. Satisfied, Aleister puts away his staff as a crimson core solidifies. An Invoked beast passes through the gateway, bearing witness to your contract.
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.pages.ALCHE: At the edge of the circle, the coins melt into three streams of differently colored liquid light. Aleister seals them in bottles and hands them to you, then returns to adjusting the dangerous markings.
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.pages.CONTR: The contract ignites at your fingertips, then swiftly turns into a brand. A low roar echoes in the distance. A more powerful Fusion Monster has already answered your call.
V_YGO_EVENT_ALEISTERS_RITUAL.selectionSc: Choose {InvokedCards} ‘Invoked’ Fusion Monsters to add to your Extra Deck.
